title: The Lips I Used to Hide
caption:
For years, I tried to make my lips disappear.

They were full, and since childhood,
they were the part of my face I liked least.
At university, I wore only beige or clear on my lips,
and let my eyes do all the talking.

Twenty years ago, I took my first job in makeup.
I was not especially good at it, nor especially drawn to it.
Then a senior colleague showed me how to draw a lip with care.
I looked in the mirror and thought, perhaps this is nice.
Lips have been my favourite ever since.

Later, at another brand, a true red arrived as the season's new colour.
I wore red for the first time in my life, and it suited me.
The woman I was only a few years before would not have believed it.

What we try to hide can become our charm, with only a little care.
Often, it is the very feature others admire.
Makeup is never quite predictable.
That is why I hope you will keep an open mind, and try.
